verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a processor, so generating insights and suggestions from user data inside the product is a software-application capability, not a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence mentions Copilot+ and partner AI apps, but those are third-party or OS software that use the chip's NPU. Nothing shows the processor itself ships an in-product insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
